lines.lyric: December illyeone kkeuteul neowa I remember
lines.lyric_hangul: December, 일년의 끝을 너와, I remember
lines.lyric_translation: December, as we end the year together, I remember

lines.lyric: Uri chueogeun nuncheoreom ssaigo
lines.lyric_hangul: 우리 추억은 눈처럼 쌓이고
lines.lyric_translation: Our memories pile up like the snow

lines.lyric_hangul: 너를 위해 남겨둔 수많은 말이 맴돌아 떨리는 걸
lines.lyric_translation: So many words I saved for you linger in my mind / Makes me nervous

parts.lyric: Neoreul wihae namgyeodun sumaneun mari maemdora

lines.lyric: Neul weropgiman haesseotteon sseulsseulhaesseotteon
lines.lyric_hangul: 늘 외롭기만 했었던, 쓸쓸했었던
lines.lyric_translation: Used to feel lonely and empty

lines.lyric: Shibiweori ijen weropji ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 12월이 이젠 외롭지 않아, ooh
lines.lyric_translation: But December is no longer lonely

lines.lyric: Naega olhae jeil jalhan il neoreul mannan geot
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 올해 제일 잘한 일
lines.lyric_translation: The best thing I ever did

lines.lyric: Neoreul mannan geot neoreul mannan geot
lines.lyric_hangul: 너를 만난 것, 너를 만난 것, 너를 만난 것
lines.lyric_translation: Was that I met you

lines.lyric: Naega olhae anhan il junge jeil jalhan il
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 올해 안한 일 중에 제일 잘한 일
lines.lyric_translation: The best thing I never did

lines.lyric: Neowa heyeojiji aneun geot hamkke inneun geot
lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 헤어지지 않은 것, 함께 있는 것
lines.lyric_translation: Was that I never broke up with you, and that I am still with you

lines.lyric_translation: Just like this, like this, like this, like this / Let us never change

lines.lyric: Naneun moreugenneunde jakku tiga naneunji
lines.lyric_hangul: 나는 모르겠는데 자꾸 티가 나는지
lines.lyric_translation: Though I don’t notice, it just keeps showing

lines.lyric: Chingudeuri nollyeo haru jongil ibi gwie geolcheottago
lines.lyric_hangul: 친구들이 놀려 하루 종일 입이 귀에 걸쳤다고
lines.lyric_translation: My friends are teasing that I’m smiling from ear to ear the whole day

lines.lyric_hangul: 혼자 있어도 내 뒤에 네가 있는 것처럼 느껴 자꾸 귀가
lines.lyric_translation: Even when I’m alone, I feel as if / You are behind me, my ears keep getting red

lines.lyric: Ppalgaejineun geol eotteokae gyesok neol saenggakae
lines.lyric_hangul: 빨개지는 걸 어떡해? 계속 널 생각해
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t help it, I keep thinking of you

lines.lyric: Euimireul tteoollyeobwado wae modu
lines.lyric_hangul: 의미를 떠올려봐도 왜 모두

lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 함께한 순간들뿐인지? 나 왠지
lines.lyric_translation: Why are they the moments I spent with you

lines.lyric: Na waenji sarange ppajeonna bwa
